description: This file contains BitBake recipe override functions written in Python, used to modify build configurations and environment setup for a specific embedded Linux build environment (likely Yocto-based). It defines functions that manipulate configuration files, environment variables, and perform file operations based on machine overrides and build parameters.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_prepend
methods.description: Prepares the SDK environment by writing 'meta/conf' to the template configuration if it exists.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_append
methods.description: Removes the 'templateconf.cfg' file if certain machine overrides are present, to prevent build issues.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_prepend
methods.description: Adds a generic layer path to the BBLAYERS variable if specific machine overrides are present.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_append
methods.description: Modifies the bblayers.conf and copies kernel images for specific machine overrides, and appends post-build flags to local.conf.
